issues.description: Reviews repeatedly advise against downloading the app, without giving a specific reason.
Most reviews advise against downloading or report download trouble, while some give only a vague negative reaction or mention unrelated problems.
The examples mostly contain brief or unclear references to songs, with one review describing a preference for older songs over sadder selections.
Reviews report that desired songs, including popular, older, local, or regional tracks, are unavailable on Spotify.
Reviews raise varied concerns about recommendations and playlists, with additional complaints about content access, interface, pricing, and other service features.
